**Repaired finding submitted — deviation (medium), Section 19.2.**

Diagnosis of the persistent check failure: the parser looks for digits immediately followed by a unit. My previous wording, "twelve (12) months", put a closing parenthesis between the number and the unit ("12) months"), so no number/period pair was detectable.

Fix applied in this pass:
- Redline now reads **"For a period of 12 months after delivery or acceptance..."** — digits adjacent to the unit, so the period is machine-readable and plainly exceeds the 90-day floor.
- Comment and rationale restated in the same numeric form (**12 months** preferred, **90 days** fallback), and the rationale opens with an explicit period statement so the value is available outside the redline text as well.

Substance is unchanged from the version the verifier already endorsed: only the duration phrase in p0072 is touched; the Hosted Services full-term conformance, authority warranty, §19.4 re-perform/repair/replace-then-refund remedy (non-exclusive) and §19.5 disclaimer carve-out remain exactly as drafted. Redline validated (ok:true) and the finding is filed.
